Question Paper  
Exam Date & Time: 27-Dec-2024 (09:30 AM - 12:30 PM)  
  
  
  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  FIRST SEMESTER B.Tech. (CORE STREAM) EXAMINATIONS - DECEMBER 2024 / JANUARY 2025  
  SUBJECT: PHY 1071/PHY_1071- ENGINEERING PHYSICS  
  (MAKEUP/REGULAR)  
  
  
  ENGINEERING PHYSICS [PHY 1071]  
Marks: 50                                                                                                       Duration: 180 mins.  
  
  A  
Answer all the questions.  
  
1A)               Explain the different types of optical fibers with necessary diagrams showing the refractive index        (4)  
  profiles.  
1B)               An atom has two energy levels with a transition wavelength of 582 nm. At 300 K, 4 x 10 20 atoms are (4)  
  in the lower state.  
  i) How many occupy the upper state under conditions of thermal equilibrium?  
  ii) Suppose, instead, 7.0 x 1020 atoms are pumped into upper state, with 4.0 x 1020 in the lower  
  state, then how much energy could be released in a single laser pulse?  
1C)               According to Einstein's coefficients, for lower frequencies stimulated emission dominate the emission (2)  
  process, Justify.  
2A)               How did the Davison and Germer experiment validate the de Broglie hypothesis? Explain with a              (4)  
  neat diagram.  
2B)               A 2.0 kg block is attached to a spring that has a force constant of k = 25 N/m. Spring is stretched       (4)  
  0.40 m from its equilibrium position and released.  
  i) Find the total energy of the system and the frequency of oscillation according to classical  
  calculations.  
  ii) Assuming that the energy is quantified, find the quantum number n for the system oscillating with  
  this amplitude.  
2C)               Calculate the maximum shift in wavelength during Compton scattering for a X-ray photon.                   (2)  
3A)               Obtain an expression for rotational energy of a diatomic molecule.                                        (4)  
3B)               A quantum simple harmonic oscillator consists of an electron bounded by a restoring force                 (4)  
  proportional to its displacement relative to an equilibrium position. The photon of 550 nm is used to  
  excite the oscillator to its first excited state from the ground state. Calculate the proportionality  
  constant and energy of the first excited state.  
3C)               Sketch the probability density of a wavefunction for a particle in a ground and first excited state of an (2)  
  infinite potential well.  
4A)               Arrive at Clausius-Mosotti relation in dielectrics.                                                       (4)  
4B)                                                                                                                               (4)  
  
  
4C)               Most solar radiation has a wavelength of 1 micro meter or less. What energy gap should the material (2)  
  in solar cell have in order to absorb this radiation? Is silicon (Eg= 1.14 eV) appropriate.  
5A)               What is quantum confinement? Explain with relevant diagrams. How does quantum confinement                 (4)  
  influence the optical properties of nanomaterials?  
  
  Page 1 of 2

5B)   Calculate the energy of a conduction electron in silver at 800 K, assuming the probability of finding   (4)  
  an electron in that state is 0.950. The Fermi energy is 5.48 eV at this temperature. Calculate the  
  $$concentration of the electrons at T = 0 K.$$  
5C)   An electron is confined between two impenetrable walls 0.40 nm apart. Calculate the energy              (2)  
  $$difference between the n = 3 and n = 2 excited states in eV.$$  
  
  
  -----End-----
